name: barbell seated military press (inside squat cage)
description: A seated overhead press performed inside a squat cage so the rack gives you safe bar positions. It builds shoulder and triceps strength.
instructions: Set a bench inside the cage and the bar at shoulder height.
Sit tall, grip the bar just outside shoulder width and unrack it.
Press the bar straight overhead until your arms are extended.
Lower it to your upper chest with control.
Keep your ribs down and your back against the pad.
